issues.detail: The Hebrew 'וְרֹחַב חֲמִשִּׁים בַּחֲמִשִּׁים' means 'and the width fifty by fifty' (i.e., fifty cubits on each side, or a square of fifty), but the Chinese renders it as '寬是五十肘，又是五十肘' ('width is fifty cubits, and again fifty cubits'), which is a mistranslation of the distributive 'בַּחֲמִשִּׁים' (fifty by fifty). The Chinese adds an extra '又是五十肘' that misrepresents the Hebrew as stating the width twice rather than expressing a fifty-by-fifty dimension.
